label: Rocket
depicts: Rocket body viewed from the side with one round window one nose cone and fins spread around the lower body
use_when: Use when the interface wants a fuller side view rocket body with a visible window and lower fins.
avoid_when: Do not use for the steeper launch rocket when the whole body should lean sharply toward the upper right.

label: Rocket
depicts: Rocket body angled sharply toward the upper right with a long pointed nose and trailing lower fins
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rocket posed like an upward launch rather than a flatter side profile.
avoid_when: Do not use for the broader side view rocket when the body should sit more horizontally with a fuller rear section.

label: Rows
depicts: One outer frame split into two stacked horizontal rows by one middle divider line
use_when: Use when the interface wants two stacked rows contained inside one shared outer frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the separate row cards when the two rows should sit apart with a visible gap between them.

label: Rows
depicts: Two separate horizontal panels stacked with one open gap between them
use_when: Use when the interface wants two stacked row panels that stay visually separate from each other.
avoid_when: Do not use for the shared frame rows when both rows should live inside one combined outer border.

label: Rows
depicts: One outer frame split into three stacked horizontal rows with two divider lines
use_when: Use when the interface wants three stacked rows inside one shared frame instead of two.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two row variants when the layout should stop at two stacked sections.
